title: Tier-Related Relay Messages
description: JSON Schema for new relay message types added by context-part billing feature (#329)

maxWorkers.description: Maximum concurrent dispatch slots per cluster

maxClusters.description: Maximum simultaneous cluster connections per org

HandshakeAckMessage.description: Server response to client handshake, includes tier limits. Replaces the bare heartbeat ack for clients that understand it.

TierUpdateMessage.description: Pushed to all connected clusters for an org when the subscription tier changes.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the tier change

ClusterRejectedPayload.description: Sent as WebSocket close reason (JSON-encoded) when cluster connection is rejected due to cluster limit. Close code: 4003.

currentCount.description: Number of clusters currently connected for the org

maxClusters.description: Maximum clusters allowed for the org's tier
